facts.fact: The page states that advertisers are charged the same CPC for whichever action a user takes on a location extension, whether visiting the website, clicking through to maps, or calling.
facts.quote: You’ll be charged the same CPC for whichever action the user takes, whether she visits your website, clicks through to maps, or calls you.

facts.fact: The page states that location extensions let potential customers click a click-to-call button or get directions to the business location in addition to clicking the headline.
facts.quote: potential customers can choose to click a click-to-call button or get directions to your location.

facts.fact: The page lists showing multiple nearby locations and dynamically inserting the city into ad text as benefits of Google AdWords location extensions.
The blog post Google AdWords Tips: Location Extensions was published on March 31, 2016.
